paragraphs.text: The Isles of Argive is an archipelago off the northeastern coast of New Argive , part of the Terisian Isles on the world of Dominaria .
During the Dark Age , the Isles of Argive formed their petty kingdom. King Lyssius ruled the Isles around 100 AR .
The isles were likely buried under the glaciers during the Ice Age and only resurfaced after the Thaw .
